youtube.notes: Voice: e.g. gospel hip hop — use run_capability with query, or youtube_video directly.

proton_mail.notes: read_screen: open_app+URL, then monitor vision (Ollama llava or gemini_api_key) — no Playwright/CDP; sign in manually in Edge (Mark never stores Proton passwords). send/compose: edge_then_cdp warm path; set prelaunch_open_app false for faster cold runs. playwright_persistent fallback for navigation only.

vision_read.notes: Standalone local-only vision capability. Actions: health | read_screen | read_camera. No third-party APIs.

telegram.notes: Prefer open_app + desktop automation; optional browser if you use web Telegram.

parse_syntax_grammar.notes: stdin JSON run.py: analyze | pipeline | rules | suffixes | prefixes | clean | transform. rules.json + suffixes.json + prefixes.json; experimental PSG tags only.

numbers_engine.notes: stdin JSON run.py: analyze | pipeline | spec | evidence | lexicon | math_evaluate | monad. Loads data/derived/numbers_engine/quantum_cipher_engine_methods.json + optional corpus evidence index.
